# 1 Enoch Chapter 17 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** My guides took me to a place where the beings there blazed like living fire — yet when they chose to, they appeared as human beings.

**2** Then they brought me to the place of darkness, and to a mountain whose peak scraped the sky.

**3** I saw where the heavenly lights are kept — the storehouses of the stars and of thunder. And in the deepest depths I saw a bow made of fire, with arrows and a quiver, a sword of fire, and every form of lightning.

**4** They brought me to the living waters, and to the fire of the west — the fire that catches the sun each time it sets.

**5** I came to a river of fire where fire flowed like water, pouring itself out into the great sea in the west.

**6** I saw the great rivers, and I came to the greatest river of all — and to the great primordial darkness. I went to the place where no living creature can go.

**7** I saw the mountains of winter darkness — the place from which all the underground waters of the deep emerge.

**8** I saw the mouths of all the earth's rivers, and the opening of the abyss itself.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Chapter 17 opens Enoch's hallucinatory cosmic tour. The journey visits the fundamental structures of the universe: fire-beings (v. 1), the world-mountain (v. 2), the cosmic arsenal of storm (v. 3), the waters of life and the western fire (v. 4), a river of fire (v. 5), the great rivers and primordial darkness (v. 6), the winter-dark mountains (v. 7), and the mouths of the rivers and the abyss (v. 8). The dynamic rendering emphasizes the first-person immediacy of the vision.*
